description: This Python source file defines the `BedrockFilesHandler` class, which manages downloading files from S3 buckets for Bedrock batch processing. It includes methods to extract S3 URIs from file IDs, parse S3 URIs, and retrieve file contents asynchronously or synchronously, interfacing with AWS SDK and external HTTP clients.
